bestBets.overview: No 9 the likely leader. Plenty of queries in this. WRITTEN IN MUNNY resuming showed good ability in strong races last time in. He has trialled well for his return and draws for the right run. STRONGHOLD started favourite on debut at Hawkesbury but was very green. He will be much better for the run. THE WILDLING resuming for a new trainer has also trialled well for her return. SAVVY DIAMOND and VISNA have trialled best of the 1st starters. KONOMIE can be an improver.

raceTips.comment: Written In Munny has been trialling very nicely leading into this prep. He wasn't far away from some very handy horses last preparation so naturally looks very well placed here. Legaselli solely contested stakes races in her first prep so the stable clearly have an opinion of her. She was pushed out to win a recent trial so looks ready to fire first up. Stronghold was green on debut but there was merit in the run. Fitter now. Savvy Diamond has been well educated by way of trials so can be forward on debut.

bestBets.overview: On pace runners 1 and 6. ORANGE TSUNAMI has placed his past couple at the Provincials. He looks the leader from barrier 4 and in this easier grade is sure to give a sight. WHO I THINK I AM had a very wide trip when just beaten 2nd up at this track. She again draws out today so will need some luck. The 1st starter GENTLE GIANT in a strong stable has trialled fairly for his debut. MILCHEL who was slow away when resuming at Gosford looks the other chance. STAY QUIET has good pace but he might struggle at the 1500 metres.

raceTips.comment: Orange Tsunami is hard-fit at this point of the prep, racing consistently and sets up as the map horse of the race. Happy to have him on top. Gentle Giant sparks interest after his latest trial effort and looks ideally suited kicking off straight over this distance range. Who I Think I Am had to work early to find a spot last time so there was a stack of merit in finishing so close. Milchel next best.

bestBets.overview: On pace runners 3 and 7. PEACE BIRD was very strong breaking through here last start. She looks to get an easy lead from the good barrier and after the claim is sure to give a sight. ROYAL CHIC ran on strongly this track and distance last start. From barrier 1 and getting blinkers for the 1st time she can settle closer today and be a danger. LONDON BOY is always a chance but he does enjoy running a place. Other hopes in a tough race to KENDALIA and GLENN'S LEGACY.

raceTips.comment: Kendalia arguably should have won last time out if not for being checked in the straight. The rise in distance looks highly advantageous now and with the blinkers going on there might be intent to settle closer in running. Peace Bird comes off a dominant maiden win here which suggests she can continue on her winning ways and that is reflective in the market. London Boy continues to race consistently and again looks well placed. Glenn's Legacy drops in grade and sets up to lead throughout so might take the power of running down.

bestBets.overview: On pace runners 1 and 5. DAYLITE had a wide trip but still ran on strongly on debut this track over 1100 metres. Fitter now he will enjoy getting to the 1200 metres. HIGHWAY ROBBERY was a better run last start in a Super maiden. From barrier 1 he looks suited here. BRUCEY resuming has good ability but the outside barrier no help. His stablemate RIVER MERSEY has trialled very well for her debut. Rough hopes to JUSTWATCHHER and SMOLENSKI.

raceTips.comment: River Mersey was solid in her most recent trial win, is ideally drawn and has Dale Cole retaining the ride for her debut. Stablemate Brucey looks the danger and has already been subject to early market support. Does draw wide, but that improves somewhat with runners coming out. There was a lot to like about the debut run from Daylite; covered ground throughout and hit the line strongly. Fitter/further are pluses. Boujee Gold resumes for a second prep sporting blinkers. No trial to reference but has upside.

bestBets.overview: On pace runners 1,5,6,8 and 10. The promising DANCER'S DELIGHT ran on strongly to just miss this track 2nd up over 1100 metres. He will appreciate getting to this distance and just needs a bit of luck from the bad barrier to be hard to beat. THE EYES HAVE IT going well this time in has plenty of pace and she has 2 wins and 1 second from 3 starts this track. STORMBRINGER had a tough run in stronger grade last start. He is another one with a very good record this track. Other chances to BRAZEN CRIME resuming and MIDNIGHT MOOSE.

raceTips.comment: The Eyes Have It comes off a last start track/trip win and sets up as the map horse of the race. Happy to stick with her. Midnight Moose is only lightly raced with a compelling winning strike rate so is impossible to knock. Dancer's Delight beat home The Eyes Have It two runs back when finding the best part of the track. Was strong to the line last time suggesting the extra trip will suit. Stormbringer is 2/2 at track/trip and has excuses in running last time out.
